```{r}
#| label: setup

# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(rnassqs)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(FedData)
library(exactextractr)
library(censusapi)

# set API keys
readRenviron("../.Renviron")
nassqs_auth(key = Sys.getenv('NASSQS_TOKEN'))
census_api_key(Sys.getenv('CENSUS_API_KEY'))

# county data
county_shapes <- tigris::counties("ID") %>%
  select(c("GEOID", "NAME"))

# names and GEOIDs
GEOID_names <- st_drop_geometry(county_shapes$NAME)
names(GEOID_names) <- st_drop_geometry(county_shapes$GEOID)
```

# Resource System

```{r}
#| label: "RS data setup"

rs_data <- expand.grid(county = county_shapes$NAME, 
                        year = seq(1990, 2020, 10))
```


## RS3 -- Size of resource system

### Agriculture

#### Percent land in farms

Data for 2002-2022 are available through the USDA NASS API. Data for 1992 were digitized from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 6. 

```{r}
#| label: "percent land in farms"

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               short_desc = c("Farm operations - acres operated",
                              "Land area, incl non-ag - acres"),
               domain_desc = "total")

land_in_farms <- nassqs(params)

land_in_farms_1992 <- read.csv("../data/perc_land_in_farms_ID_counties_1925-2022.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  select(County, Year, Perc_land_in_farms) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year",
         "land_in_farms" = "Perc_land_in_farms") %>%
  mutate(year = year-2)

# clean and join
rs_data <- land_in_farms %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = statisticcat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(land_in_farms = `AREA OPERATED` / `AREA` * 100) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  select(c(county, year, land_in_farms)) %>%
  mutate(year = (year-2)) %>%
  rbind(land_in_farms_1992) %>%
  right_join(rs_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

### Natural Amenities

#### Percent forest and shrubland

NLCD data were downloaded from https://www.mrlc.gov/viewer/

```{r}
#| label: "load NLCD data"

file_list <- subset(unzip("../data/NLCD_LndCov_1985-2020.zip", list=TRUE)$Name,
                    str_detect(unzip("../data/NLCD_LndCov_1985-2020.zip", list=TRUE)$Name, "tiff$"))
file_list <- file_list[order(file_list)]

nlcd_all_years_ID <- rast(paste0("/vsizip/../data/NLCD_LndCov_1985-2020.zip/", file_list))
names(nlcd_all_years_ID) <- seq(1985,2020,5)

# following code modified from @canderson156 at https://gis.stackexchange.com/questions/425821/calculating-proportion-of-a-polygon-covered-by-each-raster-category-using-r

sum_cover <- function(x){
  list(x %>%
    group_by(value) %>%
    summarize(total_area = sum(coverage_area)) %>%
    mutate(proportion = total_area/sum(total_area)))
  
}

land_cover_counts <- lapply(nlcd_all_years_ID, function(x) {
                            exact_extract(x = x,
                                   y = county_shapes,
                                   append_cols = "NAME",
                                   coverage_area = TRUE,
                                   summarize_df = TRUE,
                                   fun = sum_cover)
})

# end @canderson156 code

# organize into compatible data frame
names(land_cover_counts) <- names(nlcd_all_years_ID)

group_recode <- c(nlcd_colors()$Class, use.names=TRUE)
names(group_recode) <- as.character(nlcd_colors()$ID)

land_cover_percents <- bind_rows(land_cover_counts, .id="year") %>%
  mutate(land_cover = recode(result.value, !!!group_recode),
         cover_percent = result.proportion*100) %>%
  rename("county" = "NAME") %>%
  select(county, year, land_cover, cover_percent) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))
```

```{r}
#| label: "forest and shrubland"

forest <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover %in% c("Deciduous Forest", "Evergreen Forest")) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(percent_forest = sum(cover_percent))

rs_data <- left_join(rs_data, forest, by=c("county", "year"))

shrubland <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover == "Shrub/Scrub") %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(percent_shrubland = sum(cover_percent))

rs_data <- left_join(rs_data, shrubland, by=c("county", "year"))
```


### Residential

```{r}
#| label: "developed land"

developed <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover %in% c("Developed, Open Space", "Developed, Low Intensity", "Developed, Medium Intensity", "Developed High Intensity")) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(percent_developed = sum(cover_percent))

rs_data <- left_join(rs_data, developed, by=c("county", "year"))

# replace missing land with 0%
rs_data <- rs_data %>%
  mutate(across(percent_forest:percent_developed, ~ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, .x)))
```

## RS4 -- Human-constructed facilities

### Agriculture

#### Number farms per unit area

Data for 2002-2022 are available through the USDA NASS API. Data for 1992 were digitized from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 6.

```{r}
#| label: "number farms per unit area"

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               short_desc = c("Farm operations - number of operations",
                              "Land area, incl non-ag - acres"),
               domain_desc = "total")

num_farms <- nassqs(params)

num_farms_1992 <- read.csv("../data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992 & Size == "all farms") %>%
  left_join(read.csv("../data/perc_land_in_farms_ID_counties_1925-2022.csv")) %>%
  mutate(farms_per_acre = Num_farms / Total_county_land_acres) %>%
  select(County, Year, farms_per_acre) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year-2))

# clean and join
rs_data <- num_farms %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = statisticcat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(farms_per_acre = `OPERATIONS` / `AREA`) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  select(c(county, year, farms_per_acre)) %>%
  mutate(year = (year-2)) %>%
  rbind(num_farms_1992) %>%
  right_join(rs_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

### Residential

#### Number houses per unit area

Data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via `tidycensus`. Data for 1990 were digitized from https://www2.census.gov/library/publications/decennial/1990/cph-2/cph-2-14.pdf (available at https://www.census.gov/library/publications/1992/dec/cph-2.html)

```{r}
#| label: "number houses per unit area"

houses1990 <- read.csv("../data/1990_US_Census_data.csv")
houses2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "H001001",
                        year = 2000) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
houses2010 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "H001001",
                        year = 2010) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
houses2020 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "H1_001N",
                        year = 2020) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))

county_areas <- read.csv("../data/perc_land_in_farms_ID_counties_1925-2022.csv") %>%
  filter(Year >= 1990) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year-2)) %>%
  select(County, Year, Total_county_land_acres)

housing_units <- data.frame(county = c(houses1990$County,
                                       houses2000$NAME,
                                       houses2010$NAME,
                                       houses2020$NAME),
                            year = rep(seq(1990, 2020, 10), each = nrow(houses1990)),
                            housing_units = c(houses1990$Housing_Units,
                                              houses2000$value,
                                              houses2010$value,
                                              houses2020$value)) %>%
  left_join(county_areas,
            by = c("county" = "County",
                   "year" = "Year")) %>%
  mutate(housing_units_per_acre = housing_units / Total_county_land_acres) %>%
  select(county, year, housing_units_per_acre)

# join
rs_data <- left_join(rs_data, housing_units)
```

```{r}
#| label: "save RS data"

write.csv(rs_data,
          "../data/RS_data.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: "RU data setup"

ru_data <- expand.grid(county = county_shapes$NAME, 
                        year = seq(1990, 2020, 10))
```

## RU2 -- Growth or replacement rate

### Agriculture

#### Percent change in number of farms

Percent growth or decline compared to the number of farms 5 years previous. Data for 1997-2022 were downloaded from the NASS API. Data for 1987-1992 were digitized from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 6.

```{r}
#| label: "num farms change"

num_farms_1992_1987 <- read.csv("../data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(1987, 1992) & Size == "all farms") %>%
  select(County, Year, Num_farms) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year-2))

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",
               year__GE = 1997,
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "total")

num_farms_change <- nassqs(params)

farm_change <- num_farms_change %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = statisticcat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name",
         "Num_farms" = "OPERATIONS") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  select(c(county, year, Num_farms)) %>%
  mutate(year = (year-2)) %>%
  rbind(num_farms_1992_1987) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(num_farms_prev = lag(Num_farms, 1),
         farm_change = Num_farms - num_farms_prev,
         perc_farms_change = farm_change / num_farms_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_farms_change)

# join
ru_data <- left_join(ru_data, farm_change)
```

#### Change in cropland

```{r}
#| label: "cropland change"

cropland_change <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover %in% c("Pasture/Hay", "Cultivated Crops")) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(cover_percent = sum(cover_percent)) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(cropland_prev = lag(cover_percent, 1),
         cropland_change = cover_percent - cropland_prev,
         perc_cropland_change = cropland_change / cropland_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, cropland_change)

# join
ru_data <- left_join(ru_data, cropland_change)
```

### Natural Amenities

#### Change in forest and shrubland

```{r}
#| label: "forest and shrub change"

forest_change <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover %in% c("Evergreen Forest", "Deciduous Forest")) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(cover_percent = sum(cover_percent)) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(forest_prev = lag(cover_percent, 1),
         forest_change = cover_percent - forest_prev,
         perc_forest_change = forest_change / forest_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, forest_change)

# join
ru_data <- left_join(ru_data, forest_change)

shrub_change <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover == "Shrub/Scrub") %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(cover_percent = sum(cover_percent)) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(shrub_prev = lag(cover_percent, 1),
         shrub_change = cover_percent - shrub_prev,
         perc_shrub_change = shrub_change / shrub_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, shrub_change)

# join
ru_data <- left_join(ru_data, shrub_change)
```

### Residential

#### Change in developed land

```{r}
#| label: "developed change"

developed_change <- land_cover_percents %>%
  filter(land_cover %in% c("Developed, Open Space", "Developed, Low Intensity", "Developed, Medium Intensity", "Developed High Intensity")) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(cover_percent = sum(cover_percent)) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(developed_prev = lag(cover_percent, 1),
         developed_change = cover_percent - developed_prev,
         perc_developed_change = developed_change / developed_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, developed_change)

# join
ru_data <- left_join(ru_data, developed_change)

# replace missing land change with 0%
ru_data <- ru_data %>%
  mutate(across(cropland_change:developed_change, ~ifelse(is.na(.x), 0, .x)))
```

## RU4 -- Economic value

### Agriculture

#### Farms with net loss

Data for 2002-2022 were downloaded from the NASS API. Data for 1992 were digitized from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 4.

```{r}
#| label: "net cash farm"

params <- list(agg_level_desc = "county",
               state_name = "Idaho",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               short_desc = c("Income, net cash farm, of operations - operations with loss",
                              "Farm operations - number of operations"),
               domain_desc = "total")

farms_w_loss <- nassqs(params)

farms_w_loss_1992 <- read.csv("../data/1992_CensOfAg_data.csv") %>%
  left_join(read.csv("../data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv")) %>%
  filter(Size == "all farms") %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_net_loss = Farms_w_net_losses / Num_farms * 100) %>%
  rename("county" = "County",
         "year" = "Year") %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year-2)) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_farms_w_net_loss)

# clean and join
ru_data <- farms_w_loss %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = statisticcat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(perc_farms_w_net_loss = `LOSS` / `OPERATIONS` * 100) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.numeric(year)-2) %>%
  select(c(county, year, perc_farms_w_net_loss)) %>%
  rbind(farms_w_loss_1992) %>%
  right_join(ru_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

## RU6 -- Distinctive characteristics

### Agriculture

#### Farm sizes

2002-2022 data are downloaded from NASS API. Data for 1992 were digitized from https://agcensus.library.cornell.edu/census_parts/1992-idaho/, Chapter 2, Table 6. 

The range is described by size categories that add up to 100% of farms, so for these data, we use PCA scores that describe >75% of the variance rather than the raw data (following the methods of Aho et al., 2022).

```{r}
#| label: "farm sizes"

# farm sizes range
# list parameters
params <- list(state_alpha = "ID",
               agg_level_desc = "county",
               year = c(2002, 2012, 2022),
               commodity_desc = "Farm operations",
               short_desc = "Farm operations - number of operations",
               domain_desc = "area operated")
# retrieve
farm_sizes <- nassqs(params)

# clean
farm_sizes2 <- farm_sizes %>%
  # remove redundant categories
  filter(!(domaincat_desc %in% c("AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 219 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (220 TO 259 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (260 TO 499 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (50.0 TO 69.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (70.0 TO 99.9 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (100 TO 139 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (140 TO 179 ACRES)",
                                 "AREA OPERATED: (1,000 OR MORE ACRES)"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(county_name, year),
              names_from = domaincat_desc,
              values_from = Value) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(total_farms = sum(c_across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`), na.rm=TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)`:`AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)`,
                ~.x/total_farms*100))

# 1992 data
farm_sizes_1992 <- read.csv("../data/Farm_size_1925-1992.csv") %>%
  filter(Year == 1992) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c("County", "Year"),
              names_from = "Size",
              values_from = "Num_farms") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(`under 10 acres`:`over 2,000 acres`,
                ~.x/`all farms`*100)) %>%
  # create comparable categories
  mutate(`AREA OPERATED: (1,000 TO 1,999 ACRES)` = `1,000 to 1,999 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (1.0 TO 9.9 ACRES)` = `under 10 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (10.0 TO 49.9 ACRES)` = `10 to 49 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (180 TO 499 ACRES)` = `180 to 219 acres` + `220 to 259 acres` + `260 to 499 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (2,000 OR MORE ACRES)` = `over 2,000 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (50 TO 179 ACRES)` = `50 to 69 acres` + `70 to 99 acres` + `100 to 139 acres` + `140 to 179 acres`,
         `AREA OPERATED: (500 TO 999 ACRES)` = `500 to 999 acres`) %>%
  rename("county_name" = "County",
         "year" = "Year")

# join
farm_sizes_all <- rbind(farm_sizes2[,1:9],
                        farm_sizes_1992[,c(1:2,16:22)]) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)
  
# PCA
farm_sizes_pca <- prcomp(farm_sizes_all[,-c(1:2)])
summary(farm_sizes_pca)
#biplot(farm_sizes_pca)

# join components explaining >75% of variance
ru_data <- cbind(farm_sizes_all, farm_sizes_pca$x[,1:2]) %>%
  select(county_name, year, PC1, PC2) %>%
  rename("county" = "county_name",
         "farm_size_pc1" = "PC1",
         "farm_size_pc2" = "PC2") %>%
  mutate(county = str_to_title(county),
         year = as.numeric(year)-2) %>%
  right_join(ru_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

Save resource units data:

```{r}
#| label: "save RU data"

write.csv(ru_data,
          "../data/RU_data.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
a_data <- expand.grid(county = county_shapes$NAME,

```

## A1 -- Number of Relevant Actors

### Population density

Data for 2000-2020 were downloaded via `tidycensus`. Data for 1990 were downloaded from https://www.nber.org/research/data/census-us-decennial-county-population-data-1900-1990.

```{r}
#| label: "population density"

pop1990 <- read.csv("../data/cencounts.csv") %>%
  select(pop1990, name) %>%
  filter(str_starts(name, "ID") & name != "ID Idaho") %>%
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "ID "),
         name = str_remove(name, " County"))
pop2000 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "P001001",
                        year = 2000) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
pop2010 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "P001001",
                        year = 2010) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))
pop2020 <- get_decennial(geography = "county",
                        state = "ID",
                        variables = "P1_001N",
                        year = 2020) %>%
  mutate(NAME = str_remove(NAME, " County, Idaho"))

county_areas <- read.csv("../data/perc_land_in_farms_ID_counties_1925-2022.csv") %>%
  filter(Year >= 1990) %>%
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(Year-2)) %>%
  select(County, Year, Total_county_land_acres)

pop_dens <- data.frame(county = c(pop1990$name,
                                  pop2000$NAME,
                                  pop2010$NAME,
                                  pop2020$NAME),
                            year = rep(seq(1990, 2020, 10), each = nrow(pop1990)),
                            pop = c(pop1990$pop1990,
                                    pop2000$value,
                                    pop2010$value,
                                    pop2020$value)) %>%
  left_join(county_areas,
            by = c("county" = "County",
                   "year" = "Year")) %>%
  mutate(pop_per_acre = as.numeric(pop) / Total_county_land_acres) %>%
  select(county, year, pop_per_acre)

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, pop_dens)
```

### Population change

Population data sources same as above.

```{r}
#| label: "population change"

pop1980 <- read.csv("../data/cencounts.csv") %>%
  select(pop1980, name) %>%
  filter(str_starts(name, "ID") & name != "ID Idaho") %>%
  mutate(name = str_remove(name, "ID "),
         name = str_remove(name, " County"))

pop_change <- data.frame(county = c(pop1980$name,
                                    pop1990$name,
                                    pop2000$NAME,
                                    pop2010$NAME,
                                    pop2020$NAME),
                         year = rep(seq(1980, 2020, 10), each = nrow(pop1990)),
                         pop = as.numeric(c(pop1980$pop1980,
                                 pop1990$pop1990,
                                 pop2000$value,
                                 pop2010$value,
                                 pop2020$value))) %>%
  arrange(county, year) %>%
  mutate(pop_prev = lag(pop, 1),
         pop_change = pop - pop_prev,
         perc_pop_change = pop_change / pop_prev * 100) %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990,2000,2010,2020)) %>%
  select(county, year, perc_pop_change)

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, pop_change, by = c("county", "year"))
```

```{r}
  right_join(a_data, by=c("county", "year"))
```

### Average age

Age data downloaded from https://seer.cancer.gov/popdata/download.html.

```{r}
#| label: "average age"

age_raw <- read.table(file = gzfile("../data/id.1969_2023.singleages.through89.90plus.txt.gz"),
                      sep = "\n", strip.white = TRUE)

age_formatted <- age_raw %>%
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(V1, 1, 4)),
         GEOID = substr(V1, 7, 11),
         Age = as.numeric(substr(V1, 17, 18)),
         Pop = as.numeric(substr(V1, 19, 19+8)))

age <- age_formatted %>%
  filter(year %in% c(1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names)) %>%
  group_by(county, year) %>%
  summarise(avg_age = weighted.mean(Age, Pop))

a_data <- left_join(a_data, age, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Employment rate

Raw unemployment data was downloaded from https://download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/la/ (`la.data.64.County`).

```{r}
unemployment_raw <- read.table(file = gzfile("../data/la.data.64.County.txt.gz"),
                               header = TRUE,
                               sep = "\t")

unemployment_clean <- unemployment_raw %>%
  filter(str_detect(series_id, "0000000003") &
           year %in% c(1990, 2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(value = as.numeric(value),
         GEOID = substr(series_id, 6, 10)) %>%
  filter(str_starts(GEOID, "16")) %>%
  group_by(GEOID, year) %>%
  summarise(unemployment_rate = mean(value)) %>%
  mutate(county = recode(GEOID, !!!GEOID_names)) %>%
  select(-GEOID)

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, unemployment_clean, by = c("county", "year"))
```

### Education level

Data were downloaded from https://data.ers.usda.gov/reports.aspx?ID=4026: County-Level Data Sets - Education

```{r}
#| label: "education level"

high_school <- readxl::read_excel("../data/EducationReport_HighSchool.xlsx",
                                  skip=2) %>%
  mutate(edu_level = "High school")
bachelors <- readxl::read_excel("../data/EducationReport_Bachelors.xlsx",
                                  skip=2) %>%
  mutate(edu_level = "Bachelors")
edu_level <- rbind(high_school, bachelors) %>%
  filter(Name != "Idaho") %>%
  mutate(Name = str_remove(Name, ", ID")) %>%
  pivot_longer(`1970`:`2019-2023`,
               names_to = "year",
               values_to = "percent") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(year == "2008-2012", 2010,
                       ifelse(year == "2019-2023", 2020, year))) %>%
  filter(year %in% c("1990", "2000", "2010", "2020")) %>%
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  select(Name, edu_level, percent, year) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Name, year),
              names_from = "edu_level",
              values_from = "percent")

# join
a_data <- left_join(a_data, edu_level, by = c("county" = "Name", "year"))
```
